inj.note: Murray emerged from last Sunday's loss to the Lions with a sore hamstring, and O'Connell told reporters on Thursday that the quarterback was unlikely to play in Week 9 but also wasn't an IR consideration. reporters Netflix reported Saturday morning that Murray is in recovery mode from a Grade 2 hamstring strain that will sideline him Monday and potentially beyond that point. Now that Murray officially is out for his second contest of the campaign, Carson Wentz is set to see his first game action since Week 2.

news.h: Vikings to start QB Carson Wentz against Bills with Kyler Murray ruled out
news.d: Vikings quarterback Carson Wentz will start Monday night's game against the Buffalo Bills with Kyler Murray ruled out with a hamstring injury.

news.h: Vikings uncertain of QB Kyler Murray's status vs. Bills due to sore hamstring
news.d: Vikings QB Kyler Murray's status for the Week 9 game against the Bills is uncertain due to a sore hamstring.

news.h: Vikings acknowledge Justin Jefferson's frustration: Must get him the ball
news.d: Justin Jefferson declined to speak with reporters after Sunday's loss, and coach Kevin O'Connell and QB Kyler Murray acknowledged the receiver's disposition.
